meta.source: Reserve Bank of India, Handbook of Statistics on Indian States (via DBIE)
meta.coverage: State-wise Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) Score: RBI Handbook of Statistics on Indian States, Table 106
meta.note: DBIE report 1651, data provider "Main". Values exactly as DBIE serves them; each series carries its unit (scripts/lib/products/states.mjs HBS_UNITS, read from the table's unit column and divisor); DBIE's unit column says: ACTUAL. Periods: as on the date served. Dimensions: none; measures: value. Jammu & Kashmir to 2018-19 (with Ladakh) and from 2019-20 (the UT) are separate series; 2019-20 straddles the change of 31 October 2019.
